Dali

Jizu Mountain pilgrimage day trip

Jizu Mountain by shuttle bus and cableway — one of China's great Buddhist mountains, and the cradle of Chan Buddhism.

Request a Call

Itinerary

  • 08:00–08:30Board at the south gate of Dali old town and depart.
  • JourneyDrive to Jizu mountain — a major Buddhist site in Southeast Asia, where Chinese Han and Tibetan Buddhism meet, and the cradle of Chan Buddhism. Known as the first Buddhist mountain of China.
  • 09:30Arrive at the "Lingshan Yihui" gateway arch.
  • 10:00Zhongsheng Zen temple: the release pond, Zhenbao pavilion, Yunyi rock, Heavenly Kings hall, main hall and the ancestral hall.
  • 12:00Lunch, own arrangement — vegetarian food available at own cost. Sixty minutes.
  • 14:30Shuttle bus and cableway to the summit; Jinding temple and the golden hall.
  • 15:30Cableway and shuttle bus back to the mountain gate.
  • 16:30Coach from Zhusheng temple back to Dali old town. Trip ends.
